issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: Drop dead! I hope to see you in your coffin, in your white funeral slippers! May you have to live on nothing but your wages!
issues.justification: The neighbor's curse is in a dialectal, Odessa-flavored voice (у гробу, у белых тапках); the English is standard and loses the character's comic voice. The wage curse is also flattened.

issues.source_quote: Нет, шуба подождёт. Я считаю, главное - это поглядеть мир! А то действительно работает, работает...
issues.justification: Minor, but the preceding 'Ха-х-х' and the interviewer's lines are fused; more importantly the interviewer's speech and Gorbunkov's get mixed in the dialogue, obscuring who speaks.

issues.translation_quote: Fris Street, Fish Street, - The Chikanuk Pharmacy...
issues.justification: The spy-address rehearsal is Gorbunkov being coached and Gesha's slip; 'Fris Street' and the garbled 'рыбна улица' lose the mangled foreign-language joke. Also 'Чёрт побери' is the password, and the translation weakens its role by rendering it as 'God damn it'/'Damn it' inconsistently.
Loss of dialect and comedic over-the-top Odessa curse style.
The comedic effect of foreigners and Gorbunkov mangling the password 'Щёрт/Шьёрт побери' with accent is lost; all rendered as plain 'Damn it', so the scene's humor of mispronunciation disappears.

issues.source_quote: Нет, я никуда не еду. Мы провожаем папу!!!
issues.translation_quote: No, I'm not going anywhere. We're seeing Daddy off!
issues.justification: Acceptable meaning, but the children's line is undermined by mangled sequence; the 'Ой! Ну что же это такое' and 'Ну разве можно!' are misattributed, weakening the comic structure.

issues.source_quote: Упал, выругался... Чёрт возьми! Ух, прости, "Чёрт побери!"
issues.translation_quote: You fall, you swear... "God damn it!" Oh, sorry: "Damn it!"
issues.justification: The joke is that 'Чёрт возьми' is the wrong password and 'Чёрт побери' the right one; English renders both as near-identical oaths, so the correction joke and the password plot point are blurred.

issues.source_quote: Лёлик, на его месте должен быть я. Напьёшься - будешь!
issues.translation_quote: Boys, I should be the one lying there. Get drunk and you will be!
issues.justification: The scene is a street drunk joke; 'Ребята' mistranslated as 'Boys' and the joke about the drunk lying on the ground is weakened.
The 'коляска' here is a motorcycle sidecar, not a stroller; mistranslation.

The running gag of Lyolik deliberately mangling the name into 'goat-molester' (Kozlodoyev) is not carried by any explanation or English pun, so the insult is lost; the initial introduction was also rendered 'Kozodoyev' without hint.
Acceptable, but the Soviet slogan register of the building manager is flattened; also 'Тлетворное влияние Запада' flows fine. Less severe overall.
Nadya accuses him of marital infidelity ('измена' = adultery/betrayal in context of mistress); 'treason' misleads and breaks the following 'my wife, mother of my children' reaction.
Fine, but the note 'туалэт, типа сортир ... «Мэ» и «Жо»' renders as 'M' and 'W', losing the Russian М/Ж marking joke; acceptable but weakened.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a whole book of tickets and you might just win... A water pump!
issues.justification: The rhyming pitch (пачку/водокачку) is a comic doggerel; the English loses the rhyme and humor.
'Closed fracture' is rendered as 'simple fracture', and the later 'открытый перелом' as 'compound fracture'; the Nadya joke works but 'simple' loses the clear closed/open contrast.

issues.source_quote: Эти игрушки идиотские! ... Собака друг человека
issues.justification: Fine, but earlier 'Собака - друг человека! ... Управдом - друг человека!' fully works. Mostly acceptable.

issues.source_quote: Вы в самодеятельности участвуете? Участвую. Зачем я соврал, я ж не учавствую?
issues.translation_quote: Do you do amateur theater? I do. Why did I lie? I don't!
issues.justification: 'Самодеятельность' means amateur performance/talent shows generally, and the point is a cover story; fine but 'amateur theater' narrows it.

issues.source_quote: Врачи рекомендуют... Снотворное... В неделе... для дома, для семьи...
issues.translation_quote: Doctors recommend... Sleeping pills... In Nedelya... the family section...
issues.justification: Nedelya is a Soviet weekly newspaper supplement; left untranslated and unexplained, so the reference is opaque to English viewers.

issues.source_quote: Такова «сё ля ви», как говорят у них
issues.translation_quote: That's "c'est la vie," as they say here...
issues.justification: 'У них' means 'over there/in the West', not 'here'; reverses the meaning.
Fine as nonsense; low importance.
Acceptable.
Unclear; 'Не надо' is hesitant tourist-farewell talk, and the rendering is cryptic.

issues.translation_quote: Send a taxi to the Weeping Willow restaurant
issues.justification: Fine.
Too technical, unnatural for spoken English; 'another hundred and fifty' or 'another glass' would sound natural.

The recurring running gag of the boss's cynical aphorisms (often garbled: 'куй железо, не отходя от кассы') loses the mixed-proverb humor, as 'strike while the iron's hot' drops the cash register element.

issues.source_quote: Куй железо, не отходя от кассы!
issues.justification: The joke is the hybrid of two sayings (ковать железо + не отходя от кассы); the English omits the cash-register half, so the comic mix is lost.

issues.source_quote: Ладыженский, Евгений Николаевич, школьный друг этого дурика!
issues.justification: Fine; but 'Колыма' remains the unexplained gulag reference; the joke about Kolyma lost for audience.
Fine.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No, I can't agree to that!
issues.justification: Gorbunkov's mock-bureaucratic/folk 'пойтить' is flattened, losing comic voice.

issues.source_quote: Как говорил один мой знакомый, покойник: Я слишком много знал...
issues.justification: Acceptable.
